details: This package version is a non-functional placeholder: a 336-byte tarball containing only a package.json and a README, with no JavaScript, no lifecycle hooks, no bin entries, no dependencies and no network or filesystem activity. The README describes it as a "Temporary Holding Version" whose operational replacement is awaiting a staged release, indicating the name is being reserved ahead of a payload release. The package name is a combosquat of the widely used `baileys` WhatsApp library. No IOCs are present in this version; the analysis is metadata-only and the operational payload is not included in this tarball.
